user.title: Wing Delivery
user.description: Connect the mailbox that receives your Wing order emails. Nothing is stored outside Home Assistant.

data_description.email_scan_interval: How often to check your mailbox for a new Wing order. Slower is fine — orders are infrequent (default 120).
data_description.live_scan_interval: How often to refresh the ETA and the drone's map position while a delivery is in the air. Lower is smoother; your mailbox is still only checked at the interval above, so this doesn't hit email more often (default 20).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter mailbox password
reauth_confirm.description: The mailbox rejected the saved password for {username}. Enter the current password (an app password for Gmail).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the mailbox. Check the host and port, and that the server presents a valid TLS certificate.
error.invalid_auth: The mailbox rejected the username or password. If you use Gmail with 2-Step Verification, you must use an app password (myaccount.google.com/apppasswords), not your normal password.

abort.reauth_successful: Password updated. Wing Delivery will resume checking the mailbox.

data_description.email_scan_interval: How often to check your mailbox for a new Wing order.
data_description.live_scan_interval: How often to refresh the ETA and drone map position during an active delivery.
